037/**
038 * Session object that lives for the duration of a single use of {@link YamlParser}.
039 *
040 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
041 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
042 * </ul>
043 */
044@SuppressWarnings({
045   "java:S125",  // State-machine and parse-path comments are documentation, not commented-out code
046   "java:S135",  // Multiple break/continue acceptable for YAML parsing state machines
047   "java:S2589", // State checks in error path - analyzer FP on state machine flow
048   "java:S2677", // r.read() return value intentionally ignored when consuming/skipping chars
049   "java:S3626", // Redundant jump acceptable for state machine clarity
050   "unchecked",
051   "rawtypes",
052   "resource" // Closeable resources are owned by the caller's parser session; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
053})
054public class YamlParserSession extends ReaderParserSession implements RecordReadable, ArrayRecordReadable {
055
056   /**
057    * Builder class.
058    */
059   public static class Builder extends ReaderParserSession.Builder<Builder> {
060
061      private YamlParser ctx;
062
063      /**
064       * Constructor
065       *
066       * @param ctx The context creating this session.
067       */
068      protected Builder(YamlParser ctx) {
069         super(ctx);
070         this.ctx = ctx;
071      }
072
073      @Override
074      public YamlParserSession build() {
075         return new YamlParserSession(this);
076      }
077
078   }

086    */
087   public static Builder create(YamlParser ctx) {
088      return new Builder(ctx);
089   }

106   @Override /* Overridden from ParserSession */
107   protected <T> T doRead(ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
108      try (var r = pipe.getParserReader()) {
109         if (r == null)
110            return null;
111         return readAnything(type, r, getOuter(), null);
112      }
113   }

115   /**
116    * Opens a whole-value pull-parser cursor over a YAML document, bound to this live session.
117    * {@link RecordReader#read(Class) read(...)} delegates to the polymorphic
118    * {@link ParserSession#read(Object, Class)} entry point.
119    *
120    * @param input The input.
121    * @return A new {@link RecordReader} cursor.
122    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying input.
123    */
124   @Override /* RecordReadable */
125   public RecordReader readRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
126      return RecordAdapter.reader(this, input);
127   }
128
129   /**
130    * Buffered array-element {@link RecordReader} for YAML, bound to this live session.  Calls
131    * {@code parse(input, List.class, Object.class)} once and iterates the result.
132    *
133    * <h5 class='section'>Streaming status:</h5>
134    * <p>
135    * A top-level YAML block sequence ({@code - elem} per line) <i>is</i> forward-readable in
136    * principle, so true element-at-a-time streaming is <b>feasible</b> here (unlike Parquet/BSON).
137    * It is left buffered for now: Juneau's YAML reader is a single hand-written indentation state
138    * machine ({@code readBlockSequence}/{@code readFlowSequence}) whose per-element advance and
139    * dedent bookkeeping are not currently exposed as a pull cursor, and extracting that safely is a
140    * non-trivial parser refactor with real regression surface.  This
141    * is demand-driven &mdash; convert when a large-YAML-array use case justifies the refactor.
142    *
143    * @param input The input.
144    * @return A buffered {@link RecordReader}.
145    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred reading the input.
146    */
147   @Override /* ArrayRecordReadable */
148   public RecordReader readArrayRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
149      return RecordAdapter.arrayReader(this, input);
150   }
151
152   /**
153    * The YAML record cursor is buffered/{@link RecordAdapter}-backed, not O(1) streaming.
154    *
155    * @return Always <jk>false</jk>.
156    */
157   @Override /* RecordReadable */
158   public boolean isRecordStreaming() { return false; }
159
160   /**
161    * The YAML array-record cursor is buffered/{@link RecordAdapter}-backed, not O(1) streaming.
162    *
163    * <p>
164    * Genuine streaming is feasible for YAML block sequences but deferred (demand-driven) pending a
165    * pull-cursor refactor of the indentation state machine; see {@link #readArrayRecords(Object)}.
166    *
167    * @return Always <jk>false</jk>.
168    */
169   @Override /* ArrayRecordReadable */
170   public boolean isArrayRecordStreaming() { return false; }
171
172   @Override /* Overridden from ReaderParserSession */
173   protected <E> Collection<E> doReadIntoCollection(ParserPipe pipe, Collection<E> c, Type elementType) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
174      try (var r = pipe.getParserReader()) {
175         skipWhitespaceAndComments(r);
176         int ch = r.peek();
177         if (ch == '[') {
178            readFlowSequence(r, c, getClassMeta(elementType), null);
179         } else {
180            readBlockSequence(r, c, getClassMeta(elementType), null, 0);
181         }
182         return c;
183      }
184   }
185
186   @Override /* Overridden from ReaderParserSession */
187   protected <K,V> Map<K,V> doReadIntoMap(ParserPipe pipe, Map<K,V> m, Type keyType, Type valueType) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
188      try (var r = pipe.getParserReader()) {
189         skipWhitespaceAndComments(r);
190         int ch = r.peek();
191         if (ch == '{') {
192            readFlowMapping(r, m, (ClassMeta<K>)getClassMeta(keyType), (ClassMeta<V>)getClassMeta(valueType), null);
193         } else {
194            readBlockMapping(r, m, (ClassMeta<K>)getClassMeta(keyType), (ClassMeta<V>)getClassMeta(valueType), null, 0);
195         }
196         return m;
197      }
198   }

200   @SuppressWarnings({
201      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for parser dispatch
202      "java:S6541" // Brain method acceptable for parser dispatch
203   })
204   private <T> T readAnything(ClassMeta<?> eType, ParserReader r, Object outer, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
205
206      if (eType == null)
207         eType = object();
208      var swap = (ObjectSwap<T,Object>)eType.getSwap(this);
209      var builder = (BuilderSwap<T,Object>)eType.getBuilderSwap(this);
210      ClassMeta<?> sType = null;
211      if (nn(builder))
212         sType = builder.getBuilderClassMeta(this);
213      else if (nn(swap))
214         sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
215      else
216         sType = eType;
217
218      if (sType.isOptional())
219         return (T)o(readAnything(eType.getElementType(), r, outer, pMeta));
220
221      setCurrentClass(sType);
222
223      Object o = null;
224
225      skipWhitespaceAndComments(r);
226      skipDocumentMarker(r);
227      skipWhitespaceAndComments(r);
228
229      int contentColumn = r.getPosition().getColumn();
230      int c = r.peek();
231      if (c == -1) {
232         // Let o be null.
233      } else if (c == '{') {
234         if (sType.isObject()) {
235            var m2 = newGenericMap();
236            readFlowMapping(r, m2, string(), object(), pMeta);
237            o = cast(m2, pMeta, eType);
238         } else if (nn(builder)) {
239            var m = toBeanMap(builder.create(this, eType));
240            o = builder.build(this, readIntoBeanMap(r, m).getBean(), eType);
241         } else if (sType.canCreateNewBean(outer)) {
242            var m = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner());
243            o = readIntoBeanMap(r, m).getBean();
244         } else if (sType.isMap()) {
245            Map m = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Map)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericMap(sType));
246            o = readFlowMapping(r, m, sType.getKeyType(), sType.getValueType(), pMeta);
247         } else if (sType.isCollection()) {
248            var m = newGenericMap();
249            readFlowMapping(r, m, string(), object(), pMeta);
250            o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
251         } else if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) {
252            var m = newGenericMap();
253            readFlowMapping(r, m, string(), object(), pMeta);
254            o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
255         } else {
256            Map m = newGenericMap();
257            readFlowMapping(r, m, sType.getKeyType(), sType.getValueType(), pMeta);
258            if (m.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(eType)))
259               o = cast((MarshalledMap)m, pMeta, eType);
260            else if (nn(sType.getProxyInvocationHandler()))
261               o = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()).load(m).getBean();
262            else
263               throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
264         }
265      } else if (c == '[') {
266         if (sType.isObject()) {
267            o = readFlowSequence(r, newGenericList(), object(), pMeta);
268         } else if (sType.isCollection()) {
269            Collection l = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection)sType.newInstance() : newGenericList());
270            o = readFlowSequence(r, l, sType, pMeta);
271         } else if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) {
272            var l = (ArrayList)readFlowSequence(r, list(), sType, pMeta);
273            o = toArray(sType, l);
274         } else {
275            throw new ParseException(this, "Unrecognized syntax for class type '%s', starting character '%s'", sType, (char)c);
276         }
277      } else if (c == '\'') {
278         String s = readSingleQuotedString(r);
279         o = handleQuotedScalar(s, r, sType, eType, builder, outer, pMeta, contentColumn > 0 ? contentColumn - 1 : 0);
280      } else if (c == '"') {
281         String s = readDoubleQuotedString(r);
282         o = handleQuotedScalar(s, r, sType, eType, builder, outer, pMeta, contentColumn > 0 ? contentColumn - 1 : 0);
283      } else if (c == '-') {
284         int c2 = peekSecondChar(r);
285         if (c2 == ' ' || c2 == '\n' || c2 == '\r') {
286            if (sType.isObject()) {
287               o = readBlockSequence(r, newGenericList(), object(), pMeta, 0);
288            } else if (sType.isCollection()) {
289               Collection l = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection)sType.newInstance() : newGenericList());
290               o = readBlockSequence(r, l, sType, pMeta, 0);
291            } else if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) {
292               var l = (ArrayList)readBlockSequence(r, list(), sType, pMeta, 0);
293               o = toArray(sType, l);
294            } else {
295               throw new ParseException(this, "Unrecognized syntax for class type '%s', starting character '%s'", sType, (char)c);
296            }
297         } else {
298            String s = readPlainScalar(r, 0);
299            o = convertToType(s, sType, eType, outer, pMeta);
300         }
301      } else if (c == '|' || c == '>') {
302         String s = readBlockScalar(r, (char)c);
303         o = convertToType(s, sType, eType, outer, pMeta);
304      } else if (c == '~') {
305         r.read(); // consume '~'
306         // o remains null (initialized at line 255)
307      } else {
308         String s = readPlainScalar(r, 0);
309         o = handlePlainScalar(s, r, sType, eType, builder, outer, pMeta, contentColumn > 0 ? contentColumn - 1 : 0);
310      }
311
312      if (nn(swap) && nn(o))
313         o = unswap(swap, o, eType);
314
315      if (nn(parentBean()))
316         setParent(eType, o, parentBean());
317
318      return (T)o;
319   }

321   @SuppressWarnings({
322      "java:S107", // 8 parameters required for YAML scalar handling dispatch
323      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for scalar type dispatch
324      "java:S6541" // Brain method acceptable for scalar handling
325   })
326   private <T> Object handleQuotedScalar(String s, ParserReader r, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> eType, BuilderSwap<T,Object> builder, Object outer, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, int keyIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
327      if (looksLikeMappingKey(r)) {
328         r.read(); // consume ':'
329         int cp = r.peek();
330         if (cp == ' ')
331            r.read();
332
333         if (sType.isObject()) {
334            var m2 = newGenericMap();
335            Object value = readAnything(object(), r, m2, pMeta);
336            String ts = trim(s);
337            setName(object(), value, ts);
338            m2.put(ts, value);
339            readBlockMappingRemainder(r, m2, string(), object(), pMeta, keyIndent);
340            return cast(m2, pMeta, eType);
341         } else if (nn(builder)) {
342            var m = toBeanMap(builder.create(this, eType));
343            readBeanProperty(r, m, s);
344            readIntoBeanMapBlockRemainder(r, m, keyIndent);
345            return builder.build(this, m.getBean(), eType);
346         } else if (sType.canCreateNewBean(outer)) {
347            var m = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner());
348            readBeanProperty(r, m, s);
349            readIntoBeanMapBlockRemainder(r, m, keyIndent);
350            return m.getBean();
351         } else if (sType.isMap()) {
352            Map m = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Map)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericMap(sType));
353            Object value = readAnything(sType.getValueType(), r, m, pMeta);
354            Object key = convertAttrToType(m, trim(s), sType.getKeyType());
355            setName(sType.getValueType(), value, key);
356            m.put(key, value);
357            readBlockMappingRemainder(r, m, sType.getKeyType(), sType.getValueType(), pMeta, keyIndent);
358            return m;
359         } else {
360            var m2 = newGenericMap();
361            Object value = readAnything(object(), r, m2, pMeta);
362            m2.put(s, value);
363            readBlockMappingRemainder(r, m2, string(), object(), pMeta, keyIndent);
364            if (m2.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(eType)))
365               return cast(m2, pMeta, eType);
366            if (nn(sType.getProxyInvocationHandler()))
367               return newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()).load(m2).getBean();
368            throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
369         }
370      }
371      if (sType.isObject())
372         return trim(s);
373      return convertToType(s, sType, eType, outer, pMeta);
374   }
375
376   @SuppressWarnings({
377      "java:S107", // 8 parameters required for YAML scalar handling dispatch
378      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for scalar type dispatch
379      "java:S6541" // Brain method acceptable for scalar handling
380   })
381   private <T> Object handlePlainScalar(String s, ParserReader r, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> eType, BuilderSwap<T,Object> builder, Object outer, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, int keyIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
382      if (s.isEmpty())
383         return null;
384
385      if (looksLikeMappingKey(r)) {
386         r.read(); // consume ':'
387         int cp = r.peek();
388         if (cp == ' ')
389            r.read(); // consume space after ':'
390
391         String keyStr = isYamlNull(s) ? null : trim(s);
392         if (sType.isObject()) {
393            var m2 = newGenericMap();
394            Object value = readAnything(object(), r, m2, pMeta);
395            setName(object(), value, keyStr);
396            m2.put(keyStr, value);
397            readBlockMappingRemainder(r, m2, string(), object(), pMeta, keyIndent);
398            return cast(m2, pMeta, eType);
399         } else if (nn(builder)) {
400            var m = toBeanMap(builder.create(this, eType));
401            readBeanProperty(r, m, s);
402            readIntoBeanMapBlockRemainder(r, m, keyIndent);
403            return builder.build(this, m.getBean(), eType);
404         } else if (sType.canCreateNewBean(outer)) {
405            var m = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner());
406            readBeanProperty(r, m, s);
407            readIntoBeanMapBlockRemainder(r, m, keyIndent);
408            return m.getBean();
409         } else if (sType.isMap()) {
410            Map m = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Map)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericMap(sType));
411            Object value = readAnything(sType.getValueType(), r, m, pMeta);
412            Object key = convertAttrToType(m, keyStr, sType.getKeyType());
413            setName(sType.getValueType(), value, key);
414            m.put(key, value);
415            readBlockMappingRemainder(r, m, sType.getKeyType(), sType.getValueType(), pMeta, keyIndent);
416            return m;
417         } else {
418            var m2 = newGenericMap();
419            Object value = readAnything(object(), r, m2, pMeta);
420            m2.put(s, value);
421            readBlockMappingRemainder(r, m2, string(), object(), pMeta, keyIndent);
422            if (m2.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(eType)))
423               return cast(m2, pMeta, eType);
424            if (nn(sType.getProxyInvocationHandler()))
425               return newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()).load(m2).getBean();
426            throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
427         }
428      }
429
430      if (isYamlNull(s))
431         return null;
432
433      if ("true".equals(s) || "false".equals(s)) {
434         if (sType.isObject() || sType.isBoolean())
435            return Boolean.valueOf(s);
436         return convertToType(s, sType, eType, outer, pMeta);
437      }
438
439      return convertToType(s, sType, eType, outer, pMeta);
440   }
441
442   @SuppressWarnings({
443      "unused",    // eType, pMeta kept for API consistency with callers
444      "java:S1172" // Same as above
445   })
446   private Object convertToType(String s, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> eType, Object outer, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws ParseException {
447      if (sType.isObject()) {
448         return resolveScalarType(trim(s));
449      } else if (sType.isCharSequence()) {
450         return trim(s);
451      } else if (sType.isChar()) {
452         return parseCharacter(s);
453      } else if (sType.isNumber()) {
454         return StringUtils.parseNumber(s, (Class<? extends Number>)sType.inner());
455      } else if (sType.isBoolean()) {
456         return b(s);
457      } else if (sType.isDate()) {
458         return readDate(s, sType);
459      } else if (sType.isCalendar()) {
460         return readCalendar(s, sType);
461      } else if (sType.isTemporal()) {
462         return readTemporal(s, sType);
463      } else if (sType.isDuration()) {
464         return readDuration(s);
465      } else if (sType.isPeriod()) {
466         return readPeriod(s);
467      } else if (sType.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(outer)) {
468         return sType.newInstanceFromString(outer, s);
469      } else {
470         throw new ParseException(this, "Unrecognized syntax for class type '%s', value '%s'", sType, s);
471      }
472   }

474   private static boolean looksLikeMappingKey(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
475      return r.peek() == ':';
476   }
477
478   private static boolean isYamlNull(String s) {
479      return "null".equals(s) || "Null".equals(s) || "NULL".equals(s) || "~".equals(s);
480   }

482   private <K,V> void readBlockMappingRemainder(ParserReader r, Map<K,V> m, ClassMeta<K> keyType, ClassMeta<V> valueType, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, int parentIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
483      readBlockMapping(r, m, keyType, valueType, pMeta, parentIndent);
484   }
485
486   private <T> void readIntoBeanMapBlockRemainder(ParserReader r, BeanMap<T> m, int parentIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
487      readIntoBeanMapBlock(r, m, parentIndent);
488   }
489
490   private <T> void readBeanProperty(ParserReader r, BeanMap<T> m, String currAttr) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
491      var pb = swapParentBean(m.getBean(false));
492      try {
493      var pm = m.getPropertyMeta(currAttr);
494      setCurrentProperty(pm);
495      if (pm == null) {
496         onUnknownProperty(currAttr, m, readAnything(object(), r, m.getBean(false), null));
497      } else {
498         var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pm.getBeanInfo();
499         Object value = readAnything(cm, r, m.getBean(false), pm);
500         setName(cm, value, currAttr);
501         try {
502            pm.set(m, currAttr, value);
503         } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
504            onBeanSetterException(pm, e);
505            throw e;
506         }
507      }
508      } finally {
509         swapParentBean(pb);
510      }
511      setCurrentProperty(null);
512   }
513
514   private static boolean isNullBlockValue(ParserReader r, int blockIndent) throws IOException {
515      int c = r.peek();
516      if (c == -1)
517         return true;
518      if (c != '\n' && c != '\r')
519         return false;
520      int charsRead = 0;
521      while (true) {
522         c = r.read();
523         if (c == -1) {
524            for (int j = 0; j < charsRead; j++) r.unread();
525            return true;
526         }
527         charsRead++;
528         if (c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != ' ' && c != '\t')
529            break;
530      }
531      int nextColumn = r.getPosition().getColumn() - 1;
532      for (int j = 0; j < charsRead; j++) r.unread();
533      return nextColumn <= blockIndent;
534   }
535
536   private static int peekSecondChar(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
537      r.read();
538      int c2 = r.peek();
539      r.unread();
540      return c2;
541   }
542
543   // ==========================================
544   // Flow mapping: { key: value, ... }
545   // ==========================================
546   @SuppressWarnings({
547      "java:S1168",
548      "java:S135",
549      "java:S2583",
550      "java:S3776",
551      "java:S6541" // Brain method acceptable for flow mapping state machine
552   })
553   private <K,V> Map<K,V> readFlowMapping(ParserReader r, Map<K,V> m, ClassMeta<K> keyType, ClassMeta<V> valueType, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
554
555      if (keyType == null)
556         keyType = (ClassMeta<K>)string();
557
558      // S1: Looking for outer {
559      // S2: Looking for key start or }
560      // S3: Found key, looking for :
561      // S4: Found :, looking for value
562      // S5: Looking for , or }
563      // S6: Found , looking for key start
564
565      var state = S1;
566      String currKey = null;
567      int c = 0;
568      while (c != -1) {
569         c = r.read();
570         if (state == S1) {
571            if (c == '{')
572               state = S2;
573            else if (isWhitespace(c))
574               continue;
575            else
576               break;
577         } else if (state == S2) {
578            if (c == '}') {
579               return m;
580            } else if (isWhitespace(c)) {
581               continue;
582            } else {
583               r.unread();
584               currKey = readFlowMappingKey(r);
585               state = S3;
586            }
587         } else if (state == S3) {
588            if (c == ':')
589               state = S4;
590            else if (isWhitespace(c))
591               continue;
592         } else if (state == S4) {
593            if (isWhitespace(c))
594               continue;
595            r.unread();
596            K key = convertAttrToType(m, currKey, keyType);
597            V value = readAnything(valueType, r, m, pMeta);
598            setName(valueType, value, key);
599            m.put(key, value);
600            state = S5;
601         } else if (state == S5) {
602            if (c == ',') {
603               state = S6;
604            } else if (isWhitespace(c)) {
605               continue;
606            } else if (c == '}') {
607               return m;
608            } else {
609               break;
610            }
611         } else if (state == S6) {
612            if (c == '}') {
613               break;
614            } else if (isWhitespace(c)) {
615               continue;
616            } else {
617               r.unread();
618               currKey = readFlowMappingKey(r);
619               state = S3;
620            }
621         }
622      }
623      if (state == S1)
624         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected '{' at beginning of YAML flow mapping.");
625      if (state == S2)
626         throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find key in YAML flow mapping.");
627      if (state == S3)
628         throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find ':' following key in YAML flow mapping.");
629      if (state == S4)
630         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected value in YAML flow mapping.");
631      if (state == S5)
632         throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find '}' marking end of YAML flow mapping.");
633      if (state == S6)
634         throw new ParseException(this, "Unexpected '}' found in YAML flow mapping.");
635
636      return null; // Unreachable.
637   }
638
639   private String readFlowMappingKey(ParserReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
640      int c = r.peek();
641      if (c == '\'' )
642         return readSingleQuotedString(r);
643      if (c == '"')
644         return readDoubleQuotedString(r);
645      var key = readPlainFlowKey(r);
646      if (isYamlNull(key))
647         return null;
648      return key;
649   }
650
651   private static String readPlainFlowKey(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
652      var sb = new StringBuilder();
653      int c;
654      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
655         if (c == ':' || c == ',' || c == '}' || c == '{' || c == '[' || c == ']') {
656            r.unread();
657            break;
658         }
659         sb.append((char)c);
660      }
661      return sb.toString().trim();
662   }
663
664   // ==========================================
665   // Flow sequence: [ value, ... ]
666   // ==========================================
667   @SuppressWarnings({
668      "java:S1168",
669      "java:S135",
670      "java:S2583",
671      "java:S3776"
672   })
673   private <E> Collection<E> readFlowSequence(ParserReader r, Collection<E> l, ClassMeta<?> type, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
674
675      // S1: Looking for outermost [
676      // S2: Looking for value or ]
677      // S3: Looking for , or ]
678      // S4: Looking for value
679
680      int argIndex = 0;
681
682      var state = S1;
683      int c = 0;
684      while (c != -1) {
685         c = r.read();
686         if (state == S1) {
687            if (c == '[')
688               state = S2;
689            else if (isWhitespace(c))
690               continue;
691            else
692               break;
693         } else if (state == S2) {
694            if (c == ']') {
695               return l;
696            } else if (isWhitespace(c)) {
697               continue;
698            } else if (c != -1) {
699               r.unread();
700               l.add((E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), r, l, pMeta));
701               state = S3;
702            }
703         } else if (state == S3) {
704            if (c == ',') {
705               state = S4;
706            } else if (isWhitespace(c)) {
707               continue;
708            } else if (c == ']') {
709               return l;
710            } else {
711               break;
712            }
713         } else if (state == S4) {
714            if (isWhitespace(c)) {
715               continue;
716            } else if (c == ']') {
717               break;
718            } else if (c != -1) {
719               r.unread();
720               l.add((E)readAnything(type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType(), r, l, pMeta));
721               state = S3;
722            }
723         }
724      }
725      if (state == S1)
726         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected '[' at beginning of YAML flow sequence.");
727      if (state == S2)
728         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected value or ']' in YAML flow sequence.");
729      if (state == S3)
730         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected ',' or ']' in YAML flow sequence.");
731      if (state == S4)
732         throw new ParseException(this, "Unexpected trailing comma in YAML flow sequence.");
733
734      return null; // Unreachable.
735   }
736
737   // ==========================================
738   // Block mapping
739   // ==========================================
740   @SuppressWarnings({
741      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for block mapping parsing
742   })
743   private <K,V> Map<K,V> readBlockMapping(ParserReader r, Map<K,V> m, ClassMeta<K> keyType, ClassMeta<V> valueType, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, int parentIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
744
745      if (keyType == null)
746         keyType = (ClassMeta<K>)string();
747
748      int blockIndent = -1;
749
750      while (true) {
751         int consumed = skipBlanksAndCountIndent(r);
752         int lineIndent = r.getPosition().getColumn();
753         int c = r.peek();
754         if (c == -1)
755            break;
756
757         if (blockIndent == -1) {
758            if (lineIndent <= parentIndent && parentIndent > 0) {
759               unreadSpaces(r, consumed);
760               break;
761            }
762            blockIndent = lineIndent;
763         }
764
765         if (lineIndent < blockIndent) {
766            unreadSpaces(r, consumed);
767            break;
768         }
769
770         c = r.peek();
771         if (c == '#') {
772            skipToEndOfLine(r);
773            continue;
774         }
775
776         String keyStr = trim(readBlockMappingKey(r));
777
778         c = r.read(); // Should be ':'
779         if (c != ':')
780            throw new ParseException(this, "Expected ':' after key in YAML block mapping, found '%s'", (char)c);
781
782         c = r.peek();
783         if (c == ' ')
784            r.read();
785         K key = convertAttrToType(m, keyStr, keyType);
786         V value = (V)readAnything(valueType, r, m, pMeta);
787         setName(valueType, value, key);
788         m.put(key, value);
789      }
790
791      return m;
792   }
793
794   private static int skipBlanksAndCountIndent(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
795      int indent = 0;
796      int c;
797      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
798         if (c == ' ') {
799            indent++;
800         } else if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
801            indent = 0;
802         } else if (c == '\t') {
803            indent++;
804         } else {
805            r.unread();
806            break;
807         }
808      }
809      return indent;
810   }
811
812   private static void unreadSpaces(ParserReader r, int count) throws IOException {
813      for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
814         r.unread();
815   }
816
817   private String readBlockMappingKey(ParserReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
818      int c = r.peek();
819      if (c == '\'')
820         return readSingleQuotedString(r);
821      if (c == '"')
822         return readDoubleQuotedString(r);
823      var sb = new StringBuilder();
824      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
825         if (c == ':') {
826            int next = r.peek();
827            if (next == ' ' || next == '\n' || next == '\r' || next == -1) {
828               r.unread();
829               break;
830            }
831            sb.append((char)c);
832         } else if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
833            r.unread();
834            break;
835         } else {
836            sb.append((char)c);
837         }
838      }
839      String key = sb.toString().trim();
840      if (isYamlNull(key))
841         return null;
842      return key;
843   }
844
845   // ==========================================
846   // Block mapping for beans
847   // ==========================================
848   @SuppressWarnings({
849      "java:S3776"
850   })
851   private <T> BeanMap<T> readIntoBeanMap(ParserReader r, BeanMap<T> m) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
852      int c = r.peek();
853      if (c == '{') {
854         return readIntoBeanMapFlow(r, m);
855      }
856      return readIntoBeanMapBlock(r, m, 0);
857   }
858
859   @SuppressWarnings({
860      "java:S1168",
861      "java:S2583",
862      "java:S3776",
863      "java:S6541" // Brain method acceptable for bean map flow state machine
864   })
865   private <T> BeanMap<T> readIntoBeanMapFlow(ParserReader r, BeanMap<T> m) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
866
867      // S1: Looking for outer {
868      // S2: Looking for attrName start.
869      // S3: Found attrName end, looking for :.
870      // S4: Found :, looking for valStart.
871      // S5: Looking for , or }
872
873      var state = S1;
874      var currAttr = "";
875      int c = 0;
876      var pb = swapParentBean(m.getBean(false));
877      mark();
878      try {
879         while (c != -1) {
880            c = r.read();
881            if (state == S1) {
882               if (c == '{')
883                  state = S2;
884               else if (isWhitespace(c))
885                  continue;
886               else
887                  break;
888            } else if (state == S2) {
889               if (c == '}') {
890                  return m;
891               } else if (isWhitespace(c)) {
892                  continue;
893               } else {
894                  r.unread();
895                  mark();
896                  currAttr = readFlowMappingKey(r);
897                  state = S3;
898               }
899            } else if (state == S3) {
900               if (c == ':')
901                  state = S4;
902               else if (isWhitespace(c))
903                  continue;
904            } else if (state == S4) {
905               if (isWhitespace(c))
906                  continue;
907               if (! currAttr.equals(getBeanTypePropertyName((ClassMeta<?>) m.getBeanInfo()))) {
908                  var pm = m.getPropertyMeta(currAttr);
909                  setCurrentProperty(pm);
910                  if (pm == null) {
911                     onUnknownProperty(currAttr, m, readAnything(object(), r.unread(), m.getBean(false), null));
912                     unmark();
913                  } else {
914                     unmark();
915                     var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pm.getBeanInfo();
916                     Object value = readAnything(cm, r.unread(), m.getBean(false), pm);
917                     setName(cm, value, currAttr);
918                     try {
919                        pm.set(m, currAttr, value);
920                     } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
921                        onBeanSetterException(pm, e);
922                        throw e;
923                     }
924                  }
925                  setCurrentProperty(null);
926               }
927               state = S5;
928            } else if (state == S5) {
929               if (c == ',')
930                  state = S2;
931               else if (isWhitespace(c))
932                  continue;
933               else if (c == '}') {
934                  return m;
935               }
936            }
937         }
938         if (state == S1)
939            throw new ParseException(this, "Expected '{' at beginning of YAML flow mapping.");
940         if (state == S2)
941            throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find attribute name in YAML flow mapping.");
942         if (state == S3)
943            throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find ':' following attribute name in YAML flow mapping.");
944         if (state == S4)
945            throw new ParseException(this, "Expected value in YAML flow mapping.");
946         if (state == S5)
947            throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find '}' marking end of YAML flow mapping.");
948      } finally {
949         unmark();
950         swapParentBean(pb);
951      }
952
953      return null; // Unreachable.
954   }
955
956   @SuppressWarnings({
957      "java:S3776"
958   })
959   private <T> BeanMap<T> readIntoBeanMapBlock(ParserReader r, BeanMap<T> m, int parentIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
960
961      int blockIndent = -1;
962
963      var pb = swapParentBean(m.getBean(false));
964      mark();
965      try {
966         while (true) {
967            int consumed = skipBlanksAndCountIndent(r);
968            int lineIndent = r.getPosition().getColumn();
969            int c = r.peek();
970            if (c == -1)
971               break;
972
973            if (blockIndent == -1) {
974               if (lineIndent <= parentIndent && parentIndent > 0) {
975                  unreadSpaces(r, consumed);
976                  break;
977               }
978               blockIndent = lineIndent;
979            }
980
981            if (lineIndent < blockIndent) {
982               unreadSpaces(r, consumed);
983               break;
984            }
985
986            c = r.peek();
987            if (c == '#') {
988               skipToEndOfLine(r);
989               continue;
990            }
991
992            String currAttr = trim(readBlockMappingKey(r));
993
994            c = r.read(); // Should be ':'
995            if (c != ':')
996               throw new ParseException(this, "Expected ':' after attribute name in YAML block mapping, found '%s'", (char)c);
997
998            if (! currAttr.equals(getBeanTypePropertyName((ClassMeta<?>) m.getBeanInfo()))) {
999               var pm = m.getPropertyMeta(currAttr);
1000               setCurrentProperty(pm);
1001               if (pm == null) {
1002                  c = r.peek();
1003                  if (c == ' ')
1004                     r.read();
1005                  Object v = isNullBlockValue(r, blockIndent) ? null : readAnything(object(), r, m.getBean(false), null);
1006                  onUnknownProperty(currAttr, m, v);
1007                  unmark();
1008               } else {
1009                  unmark();
1010                  var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) pm.getBeanInfo();
1011                  c = r.peek();
1012                  if (c == ' ')
1013                     r.read();
1014                  Object value = isNullBlockValue(r, blockIndent) ? null : readAnything(cm, r, m.getBean(false), pm);
1015                  setName(cm, value, currAttr);
1016                  try {
1017                     pm.set(m, currAttr, value);
1018                  } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
1019                     onBeanSetterException(pm, e);
1020                     throw e;
1021                  }
1022               }
1023               setCurrentProperty(null);
1024            }
1025            mark();
1026         }
1027      } finally {
1028         unmark();
1029         swapParentBean(pb);
1030      }
1031
1032      return m;
1033   }
1034
1035   // ==========================================
1036   // Block sequence: - value\n- value\n...
1037   // ==========================================
1038   @SuppressWarnings({
1039      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for block sequence parsing
1040   })
1041   private <E> Collection<E> readBlockSequence(ParserReader r, Collection<E> l, ClassMeta<?> type, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, int parentIndent) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
1042
1043      int blockIndent = -1;
1044      int argIndex = 0;
1045
1046      while (true) {
1047         int consumed = skipBlanksAndCountIndent(r);
1048         int lineIndent = r.getPosition().getColumn();
1049         int c = r.peek();
1050         if (c == -1)
1051            break;
1052
1053         if (blockIndent == -1) {
1054            if (lineIndent <= parentIndent && parentIndent > 0) {
1055               unreadSpaces(r, consumed);
1056               break;
1057            }
1058            blockIndent = lineIndent;
1059         }
1060
1061         if (lineIndent < blockIndent) {
1062            unreadSpaces(r, consumed);
1063            break;
1064         }
1065
1066         c = r.peek();
1067         if (c == '#') {
1068            skipToEndOfLine(r);
1069            continue;
1070         }
1071         if (c != '-') {
1072            unreadSpaces(r, lineIndent);
1073            break;
1074         }
1075
1076         r.read(); // consume '-'
1077         c = r.peek();
1078         if (c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\r') {
1079            unreadSpaces(r, lineIndent);
1080            break;
1081         }
1082
1083         if (c == ' ')
1084            r.read(); // consume space after '-'
1085
1086         ClassMeta<?> elementType = type.isArgs() ? type.getArg(argIndex++) : type.getElementType();
1087         l.add((E)readAnything(elementType, r, l, pMeta));
1088      }
1089
1090      return l;
1091   }
1092
1093   // ==========================================
1094   // Single-quoted string: 'hello ''world'''
1095   // ==========================================
1096   private String readSingleQuotedString(ParserReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
1097      int c = r.read(); // consume opening '
1098      if (c != '\'')
1099         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected single quote to start string.");
1100
1101      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1102      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1103         if (c == '\'') {
1104            int next = r.peek();
1105            if (next == '\'') {
1106               r.read(); // consume escaped '
1107               sb.append('\'');
1108            } else {
1109               return sb.toString();
1110            }
1111         } else {
1112            sb.append((char)c);
1113         }
1114      }
1115      throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find end of single-quoted YAML string.");
1116   }
1117
1118   // ==========================================
1119   // Double-quoted string: "hello \"world\"\n"
1120   // ==========================================
1121   @SuppressWarnings({
1122      "java:S3776"
1123   })
1124   private String readDoubleQuotedString(ParserReader r) throws IOException, ParseException {
1125      int c = r.read(); // consume opening "
1126      if (c != '"')
1127         throw new ParseException(this, "Expected double quote to start string.");
1128
1129      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1130      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1131         if (c == '\\') {
1132            c = r.read();
1133            // @formatter:off
1134            switch (c) {
1135               case '\\': sb.append('\\'); break;
1136               case '"': sb.append('"'); break;
1137               case 'n': sb.append('\n'); break;
1138               case 't': sb.append('\t'); break;
1139               case 'r': sb.append('\r'); break;
1140               case '0': sb.append('\0'); break;
1141               case 'a': sb.append('\u0007'); break;
1142               case 'b': sb.append('\b'); break;
1143               case 'f': sb.append('\f'); break;
1144               case 'e': sb.append('\u001b'); break;
1145               case '/': sb.append('/'); break;
1146               case 'x': {
1147                  String hex = r.read(2);
1148                  try {
1149                     sb.append((char)Integer.parseInt(hex, 16));
1150                  } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
1151                     throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid \\x escape sequence in YAML string.");
1152                  }
1153                  break;
1154               }
1155               case 'u': {
1156                  String hex = r.read(4);
1157                  try {
1158                     sb.append((char)Integer.parseInt(hex, 16));
1159                  } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
1160                     throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid \\u escape sequence in YAML string.");
1161                  }
1162                  break;
1163               }
1164               default:
1165                  throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid escape sequence '\\%s' in YAML string.", (char)c);
1166            }
1167            // @formatter:on
1168         } else if (c == '"') {
1169            return sb.toString();
1170         } else {
1171            sb.append((char)c);
1172         }
1173      }
1174      throw new ParseException(this, "Could not find end of double-quoted YAML string.");
1175   }
1176
1177   // ==========================================
1178   // Plain scalar (unquoted)
1179   // ==========================================
1180   @SuppressWarnings({
1181      "unused",    // indent accepted for context but not currently used in parsing logic
1182      "java:S1172", // Same as above
1183      "java:S3776"  // Cognitive complexity acceptable for plain scalar parsing
1184   })
1185   private static String readPlainScalar(ParserReader r, int indent) throws IOException {
1186      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1187      int c;
1188      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1189         if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
1190            r.unread();
1191            break;
1192         }
1193         if (c == ':') {
1194            int next = r.peek();
1195            if (next == ' ' || next == '\n' || next == '\r' || next == -1) {
1196               r.unread(); // unread ':'
1197               break;
1198            }
1199            sb.append((char)c);
1200         } else if (c == ' ') {
1201            int next = r.peek();
1202            if (next == '#') {
1203               // rest of line is comment
1204               r.unread();
1205               break;
1206            }
1207            sb.append((char)c);
1208         } else if ((c == ',' || c == '}' || c == ']') || (c == '#' && sb.isEmpty())) {
1209            r.unread();
1210            break;
1211         } else {
1212            sb.append((char)c);
1213         }
1214      }
1215      String result = sb.toString();
1216      // Trim trailing whitespace
1217      int end = result.length();
1218      while (end > 0 && result.charAt(end - 1) == ' ')
1219         end--;
1220      return result.substring(0, end);
1221   }
1222
1223   // ==========================================
1224   // Block scalar: | or >
1225   // ==========================================
1226   @SuppressWarnings({
1227      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for block scalar parsing
1228      "java:S6541" // Brain method acceptable for block scalar state machine
1229   })
1230   private String readBlockScalar(ParserReader r, char indicator) throws IOException, ParseException {
1231      r.read(); // consume '|' or '>'
1232
1233      // Parse indicator line for chomping
1234      char chomping = ' '; // default = clip
1235      int c;
1236      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1237         if (c == '-') {
1238            chomping = '-'; // strip
1239         } else if (c == '+') {
1240            chomping = '+'; // keep
1241         } else if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
1242            if (c == '\r') {
1243               int next = r.peek();
1244               if (next == '\n')
1245                  r.read();
1246            }
1247            break;
1248         } else if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
1249            // explicit indent indicator, ignore for now (auto-detect below)
1250         } else if (c == ' ' || c == '\t') {
1251            continue;
1252         } else {
1253            throw new ParseException(this, "Unexpected character '%s' in YAML block scalar indicator.", (char)c);
1254         }
1255      }
1256
1257      // Read the block content
1258      int blockIndent = -1;
1259      var lines = new ArrayList<String>();
1260      int trailingNewlines = 0;
1261
1262      while (true) {
1263         // Count leading spaces
1264         int spaces = 0;
1265         while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1266            if (c == ' ')
1267               spaces++;
1268            else
1269               break;
1270         }
1271
1272         if (c == -1) {
1273            break;
1274         }
1275
1276         if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
1277            // Empty line
1278            trailingNewlines++;
1279            lines.add("");
1280            if (c == '\r' && r.peek() == '\n')
1281               r.read();
1282            continue;
1283         }
1284
1285         if (blockIndent == -1) {
1286            blockIndent = spaces;
1287         }
1288
1289         if (spaces < blockIndent) {
1290            // End of block, push back everything
1291            r.unread(); // push back non-space char
1292            for (int i = 0; i < spaces; i++)
1293               r.unread();
1294            break;
1295         }
1296
1297         // Read rest of line
1298         var lineSb = new StringBuilder();
1299         // Include extra spaces beyond blockIndent
1300         for (int i = blockIndent; i < spaces; i++)
1301            lineSb.append(' ');
1302         lineSb.append((char)c);
1303         while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1304            if (c == '\n' || c == '\r') {
1305               if (c == '\r' && r.peek() == '\n')
1306                  r.read();
1307               break;
1308            }
1309            lineSb.append((char)c);
1310         }
1311
1312         // Account for any blank lines that preceded this content line
1313         for (int i = 0; i < trailingNewlines; i++)
1314            lines.add("");
1315         trailingNewlines = 0;
1316         lines.add(lineSb.toString());
1317
1318         if (c == -1)
1319            break;
1320      }
1321
1322      // Build the result based on indicator and chomping
1323      var sb = new StringBuilder();
1324      for (int i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
1325         String line = lines.get(i);
1326         if (indicator == '|') {
1327            // Literal: preserve newlines
1328            if (i > 0)
1329               sb.append('\n');
1330            sb.append(line);
1331         } else {
1332            // Folded: single newlines -> space, multiple newlines preserved
1333            if (i > 0) {
1334               if (line.isEmpty() || lines.get(i - 1).isEmpty()) {
1335                  sb.append('\n');
1336               } else {
1337                  sb.append(' ');
1338               }
1339            }
1340            sb.append(line);
1341         }
1342      }
1343
1344      // Apply chomping
1345      if (chomping == '-') {
1346         // strip: no trailing newline
1347      } else if (chomping == '+') {
1348         // keep: preserve all trailing newlines
1349         sb.append('\n');
1350         for (int i = 0; i < trailingNewlines; i++)
1351            sb.append('\n');
1352      } else {
1353         // clip (default): single trailing newline
1354         sb.append('\n');
1355      }
1356
1357      return sb.toString();
1358   }

1360   // ==========================================
1361   // Helper methods
1362   // ==========================================
1363
1364   private static void skipWhitespaceAndComments(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
1365      int c;
1366      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1367         if (c == '#') {
1368            // Skip to end of line
1369            while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1370               if (c == '\n' || c == '\r')
1371                  break;
1372            }
1373         } else if (!isWhitespace(c)) {
1374            r.unread();
1375            return;
1376         }
1377      }
1378   }
1379
1380   private static void skipDocumentMarker(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
1381      int c = r.peek();
1382      if (c == '-') {
1383         r.read();
1384         int c2 = r.peek();
1385         if (c2 == '-') {
1386            r.read();
1387            int c3 = r.peek();
1388            if (c3 == '-') {
1389               r.read();
1390               // '---' found, skip rest of line
1391               skipToEndOfLine(r);
1392               return;
1393            }
1394            r.unread(); // unread second '-'
1395         }
1396         r.unread(); // unread first '-'
1397      } else if (c == '.') {
1398         r.read();
1399         int c2 = r.peek();
1400         if (c2 == '.') {
1401            r.read();
1402            int c3 = r.peek();
1403            if (c3 == '.') {
1404               r.read();
1405               // '...' found, skip rest of line
1406               skipToEndOfLine(r);
1407               return;
1408            }
1409            r.unread();
1410         }
1411         r.unread();
1412      }
1413   }
1414
1415   private static void skipToEndOfLine(ParserReader r) throws IOException {
1416      int c;
1417      while ((c = r.read()) != -1) {
1418         if (c == '\n' || c == '\r')
1419            return;
1420      }
1421   }
1422
1423   private static boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
1424      return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r';
1425   }
1426
1427   @SuppressWarnings({
1428      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for scalar type resolution
1429   })
1430   private static Object resolveScalarType(String s) {
1431      if (s == null || "null".equals(s) || "~".equals(s) || s.isEmpty())
1432         return null;
1433      if ("true".equals(s) || "True".equals(s) || "TRUE".equals(s))
1434         return Boolean.TRUE;
1435      if ("false".equals(s) || "False".equals(s) || "FALSE".equals(s))
1436         return Boolean.FALSE;
1437
1438      Object num = tryParseNumber(s);
1439      if (num != null)
1440         return num;
1441      return s;
1442   }
1443
1444   private static Object tryParseNumber(String s) {
1445      if (s.isEmpty())
1446         return null;
1447      char first = s.charAt(0);
1448      if (first != '-' && first != '+' && (first < '0' || first > '9') && first != '.')
1449         return null;
1450      try {
1451         if (s.contains(".") || s.contains("e") || s.contains("E")) {
1452            Double d = Double.parseDouble(s);
1453            return (!d.isInfinite() && !d.isNaN()) ? d : null;
1454         }
1455         return tryParseIntegerOrLong(s);
1456      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
1457         return null;
1458      }
1459   }
1460
1461   private static Object tryParseIntegerOrLong(String s) {
1462      try {
1463         return Integer.valueOf(s);
1464      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
1465         try {
1466            return Long.valueOf(s);
1467         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e2) {
1468            return null;
1469         }
1470      }
1471   }
1472}
